combat.name: Guard Tactics: Sword and Shield
combat.descriptionRaw:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 consecutive sword strikes.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to leap forward and slam the ground, dealing Physical DMG to nearby opponents.
When Valeriy has at least 40 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color>, he will consume all <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> to instead perform the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370001}Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment{/LINK}</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.{LINK#N11370002}{/LINK}
combat.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 consecutive sword strikes.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to leap forward and slam the ground, dealing Physical DMG to nearby opponents.
When Valeriy has at least 40 Impact Momentum, he will consume all Impact Momentum to instead perform the special Charged Attack Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

combat.name: Active Defense: Bastion Charge
combat.descriptionRaw: Valeriy raises his shield cannon and charges forward, dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color>, gaining 40 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color>, and deploying a Supercharged Shield.\nThe Supercharged Shield's DMG Absorption scales with Valeriy's ATK, and has 250% absorption efficiency against <color=#FFACFFFF></color>Electro DMG<color=#FFACFFFF></color>.
combat.description:
Valeriy raises his shield cannon and charges forward, dealing AoE Electro DMG, gaining 40 Impact Momentum, and deploying a Supercharged Shield.
The Supercharged Shield's DMG Absorption scales with Valeriy's ATK, and has 250% absorption efficiency against Electro DMG.

combat.name: Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo
combat.descriptionRaw: Deals <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> to nearby opponents and fires a <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderburst Shell</color> high into the air. The <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderburst Shell</color> disperses into a barrage of projectiles that rain down, dealing <color=#FFACFFFF>AoE Electro DMG</color> to nearby opponents.
combat.description: Deals AoE Electro DMG to nearby opponents and fires a Thunderburst Shell high into the air. The Thunderburst Shell disperses into a barrage of projectiles that rain down, dealing AoE Electro DMG to nearby opponents.

passive.name: Advance With the Creeping Barrage
passive.descriptionRaw: Valeriy gains 5 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color> whenever another nearby active character in the party hits an opponent with an <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro</color> attack while the <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderburst Shells</color> from his Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30605}Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo{/LINK}</color> are falling. He can gain up to 80 <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> in this way after each use of his Elemental Burst.
passive.description: Valeriy gains 5 Impact Momentum whenever another nearby active character in the party hits an opponent with an Electro attack while the Thunderburst Shells from his Elemental Burst Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo are falling. He can gain up to 80 Impact Momentum in this way after each use of his Elemental Burst.

passive.name: Into the Breach
passive.descriptionRaw: <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370002}Offensive Directive{/LINK}</color> is enhanced based on the amount of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color> consumed when performing his special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370001}Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment{/LINK}</color>. Each point consumed further increases the DMG Bonus granted by <color=#FFD780FF>Offensive Directive</color>. If Valeriy is:\n·In the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state: Each point of <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> consumed increases this DMG Bonus by an amount equal to 0.9% of Valeriy's ATK;\n·Not in the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state: Each point of <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> consumed increases this DMG Bonus by an amount equal to 0.3% of Valeriy's ATK.

passive.name: Subzero Conditioning
passive.descriptionRaw: Valeriy enters the <color=#FFD780FF>Radiance: Stellar-Conduct</color> state while within a {LINK#N11330003}<color=#FFD780FF>Polestar Field</color>{/LINK}.
passive.description: Valeriy enters the Radiance: Stellar-Conduct state while within a Polestar Field.

passive.name: Tundra Operational Intelligence
passive.descriptionRaw: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Snezhnaya (not including Nod-Krai) Expedition for 20 hours.
passive.description: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Snezhnaya (not including Nod-Krai) Expedition for 20 hours.

levels.name: The Cadence of Suppressive Fire
levels.descriptionRaw: Valeriy regenerates 6 Elemental Energy after performing the special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370001}Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment{/LINK}</color>. For every 10 <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color> consumed beyond 40 when performing this special Charged Attack, he regenerates an additional 1.5 Elemental Energy. Each time he performs <color=#FFD780FF>Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment</color>, he can regenerate up to 15 Elemental Energy in this way. This effect can trigger once every 15s.\nAdditionally, each time Valeriy enters combat, the first time he uses his Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30602}Active Defense: Bastion Charge{/LINK}</color>, he gains an additional amount of <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> equal to 150% of the amount normally gained.
levels.description:
Valeriy regenerates 6 Elemental Energy after performing the special Charged Attack Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment. For every 10 Impact Momentum consumed beyond 40 when performing this special Charged Attack, he regenerates an additional 1.5 Elemental Energy. Each time he performs Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment, he can regenerate up to 15 Elemental Energy in this way. This effect can trigger once every 15s.
Additionally, each time Valeriy enters combat, the first time he uses his Elemental Skill Active Defense: Bastion Charge, he gains an additional amount of Impact Momentum equal to 150% of the amount normally gained.

levels.name: Ranks That Charge as One
levels.descriptionRaw: All nearby party members gain 100 Elemental Mastery for 18s after Valeriy uses his Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30602}Active Defense: Bastion Charge{/LINK}</color>.\nAdditionally, while protected by a Supercharged Shield, if Valeriy is already at maximum <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color>, any further <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> he would gain is instead converted into increased DMG Absorption for the shield. Each point of excess <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> increases the Supercharged Shield's DMG Absorption by an amount equal to 8% of Valeriy's ATK. Up to 20 excess <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> can be converted in this way.
levels.description:
All nearby party members gain 100 Elemental Mastery for 18s after Valeriy uses his Elemental Skill Active Defense: Bastion Charge.
Additionally, while protected by a Supercharged Shield, if Valeriy is already at maximum Impact Momentum, any further Impact Momentum he would gain is instead converted into increased DMG Absorption for the shield. Each point of excess Impact Momentum increases the Supercharged Shield's DMG Absorption by an amount equal to 8% of Valeriy's ATK. Up to 20 excess Impact Momentum can be converted in this way.

levels.name: Vigilance at Close Quarters
levels.descriptionRaw: Increases the Level of Normal Attack <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30601}Guard Tactics: Sword and Shield{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Fortitude Unshaken by Attrition
levels.descriptionRaw: <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370003}Impact Momentum{/LINK}</color>'s limit is increased by 30, and its charging efficiency is increased by 30%.\nAdditionally, the Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#P1372101}Advance With the Creeping Barrage{/LINK}</color> is enhanced: The maximum amount of <color=#FFD780FF>Impact Momentum</color> that can be gained from this Talent after using the Elemental Burst is 104. You must unlock the Ascension Talent <color=#FFD780FF>Advance With the Creeping Barrage</color> to gain access to this effect.

levels.name: The Strength to Breach Enemy Lines
levels.descriptionRaw: The special Charged Attack <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11370001}Direct-Fire Mortar: Point-Blank Bombardment{/LINK}</color> and <color=#FFD780FF>Thunderburst Shells</color> from Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S30605}Focused Fire: Lightning Salvo{/LINK}</color> are enhanced: Their DMG is increased by 100%, and opponents they hit have the CRIT Rate of <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> they take increased by 10% for 7s. If the <color=#FFACFFFF>Electro DMG</color> taken is Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG, that DMG instance's CRIT DMG is also increased by 40%.
